### Questions for the table

- Would your neighbour need this mapping too? If yes, why would you each build it? ([J3b](en/smart-trust-demo/journeys/smart-trust-demo/workshops/dpi-h-policy-track/walkthrough/J3b/))
- Should the part of the record that crosses borders (IPS plus an immunization core) be profiled once for the region, with national extensions left sovereign? ([J4.0b](en/smart-trust-demo/journeys/smart-trust-demo/workshops/dpi-h-policy-track/walkthrough/J4.0b/))
- What would your country send to a regional connectathon within twelve months to prove this moment works? ([J4.1](en/smart-trust-demo/journeys/smart-trust-demo/workshops/dpi-h-policy-track/walkthrough/J4.1/))
